description: ViewModel class for handling coin details and managing UI state in a cryptocurrency tracking application.

classes.name: CoinDetailViewModel
classes.description: Handles the logic for displaying detailed information about a specific coin, including loading data and managing watchlist status.

classes.name: CoinDetailUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing the various states of the CoinDetail UI, including loading, success with data, and error states.

methods.name: loadCoinDetails
methods.description: Fetches and loads details about a specific coin identified by coinId.

methods.name: loadChartData
methods.description: Loads chart data for a specific coin over a given number of days.

methods.name: checkWatchlistStatus
methods.description: Checks whether the coin is present in the user's watchlist.

methods.name: toggleWatchlist
methods.description: Toggles the coin's presence in the user's watchlist.
